svg.data-cooling: hot-swappable redundant fan modules in one field-replaceable tray
svg.data-software: ONIE installer pre-loaded; Open Network Linux (ONL) compatible
svg.data-timing: IEEE1588v2 and SyncE in hardware; PRTC ITU-T G.8272; integrated GNSS receiver
svg.data-stacking: two units; 2 of 3 QSFP28 for data, 1 RJ-45 for sync, 1 RJ-45 for control
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: 1x 40/100 GbE, 4x 10/25 GbE or 2x 50 GbE per port; DAC to 2 m and AOC to 30 m when stacking
svg.data-optics-sfp28: 25 GbE, 10 GbE or 1 GbE per port
svg.data-mgmt-ports: 1x RJ-45 1000BASE-T management, 1x RJ-45 serial console, 1x USB storage
